Ghost Conversations In The Quiet
singer-songwriter folk, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, subtle piano, upright bass, brushed drums, close unpolished intimate vocal, plain spoken English, sparse atmospheric soundscape, 80 BPM

[Intro]

[Verse]
I was tracing patterns on the condensation
Just watching how the streetlight bled through slow
And I thought about the things we didn't mention
The words we swallowed down so long ago

[Chorus]
If I could just say what I meant to say
Before the silence built up this high wall
Maybe then the turning wouldn't stray
Maybe we wouldn't let it fall

[Outro]
Just the quiet now
Just the quiet now

A single worn wooden chair sits empty in a dimly lit room near a window overlooking wet pavement.
